# Tomato Paste

<section class="hmi-quick-read" id="tomato-paste-quick-read" data-hmi-quick-read aria-labelledby="tomato-paste-quick-read-label"><div class="hmi-quick-read-label" id="tomato-paste-quick-read-label">Quick read</div>

Tomato Paste in the HMI library has 220 reported results for lead, cadmium, total arsenic, inorganic arsenic, dimethylarsinic acid, total mercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, V, As, B, Ba, Ca, Mg and Mo from 7 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Okoye ONN, Okeke DO, Elekwachi VN, Ogbonna ON, Oli CC, Ijoma I, Ekoh OC, Nsude HO · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals">Batch-to-Batch Variation in Heavy Metal Concentrations in Commercial Sachet Tomato Paste Sold in Awka, Anambra State, Nigeria</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Anachem Journal 17(2), 1-10</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Oladapo FO, Awokoya JO, Egbedeyi TD · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals">COMPARATIVE RISK ASSESSMENT OF SOME TOXIC ELEMENTS&#39; For a buyer the practical points are the form bought, the basis a result is reported on, where the tomato Paste came from and the laboratory’s reporting limit. Testing finds contamination but does not remove it.

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-tomato-paste" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-tomato-paste-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of tomato paste, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

Among GEMS/Food reporting regions, tomato Paste, as sold had the lowest lead subgroup median in PAHO (3.2 µg/kg) and the highest in PAHO (250 µg/kg); reporting regions are markets, not growing areas.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> For cadmium, the lowest regional median was in EURO (30 µg/kg) and the highest in EMRO (45.1 µg/kg).<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

In one study, lead across 14 groups of tomato Paste ranged from 17 µg/kg (retail brand A, batch 4 (A4), Awka market) to 89 µg/kg (retail brand B, batch 3 (B3), Awka market); the lowest is the lowest observed in that study, not an established sourcing preference.<sup class="cite">[[sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Okoye ONN, Okeke DO, Elekwachi VN, Ogbonna ON, Oli CC, Ijoma I, Ekoh OC, Nsude HO · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals">Batch-to-Batch Variation in Heavy Metal Concentrations in Commercial Sachet Tomato Paste Sold in Awka, Anambra State, Nigeria</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Anachem Journal 17(2), 1-10</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In another study, lead across 10 groups of tomato Paste ranged from 85.4 µg/kg (retail product DTP5 (domestic (Nigerian-made), canned tin)) to 242 µg/kg (retail product DTP4 (domestic (Nigerian-made), canned tin)); the lowest is the lowest observed in that study, not an established sourcing preference.<sup class="cite">[[sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Oladapo FO, Awokoya JO, Egbedeyi TD · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals">COMPARATIVE RISK ASSESSMENT OF SOME TOXIC ELEMENTS&#39; CONTENTS IN DOMESTIC AND IMPORTED TOMATO PASTES AND KETCHUP IN NIGERIAN MARKETS</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">J. Chem. Soc. Nigeria, Vol. 48, No. 3, pp 530-543 [2023]</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<a id="universal-faqs"></a>
## Tomato Paste FAQs

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-tomato-paste" data-anchor="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-tomato-paste" data-question="What heavy metals are found in tomato Paste?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What heavy metals are found in tomato Paste?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

The library reports lead, cadmium, total arsenic, inorganic arsenic, dimethylarsinic acid, total mercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, V, As, B, Ba, Ca, Mg and Mo in tomato Paste, most often lead, cadmium and total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Okoye ONN, Okeke DO, Elekwachi VN, Ogbonna ON, Oli CC, Ijoma I, Ekoh OC, Nsude HO · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals">Batch-to-Batch Variation in Heavy Metal Concentrations in Commercial Sachet Tomato Paste Sold in Awka, Anambra State, Nigeria</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Anachem Journal 17(2), 1-10</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/okoye2026-awka-sachet-tomato-paste-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Oladapo FO, Awokoya JO, Egbedeyi TD · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals">COMPARATIVE RISK ASSESSMENT OF SOME TOXIC ELEMENTS&#39; CONTENTS IN DOMESTIC AND IMPORTED TOMATO PASTES AND KETCHUP IN NIGERIAN MARKETS</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">J. Chem. Soc. Nigeria, Vol. 48, No. 3, pp 530-543 [2023]</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/oladapo2023-nigeria-tomato-paste-ketchup-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/tokay2022-balikesir-canned-frozen-vegetables|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Tokay F · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/tokay2022-balikesir-canned-frozen-vegetables">Determination of Some Elements in Canned and Frozen Vegetables Sold in Balıkesir (Türkiye) Markets and Nutritional Assessment</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Adıyaman University Journal of Science (ADYU J SCI) 12(2), 230-243</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/tokay2022-balikesir-canned-frozen-vegetables">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> WHO GEMS/Food submissions reported lead in tomato Paste, as sold from 414 results in 4 reporting regions, with subgroup medians from 3.2 to 250 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="which-regions-report-the-lowest-levels-in-tomato-paste" data-anchor="which-regions-report-the-lowest-levels-in-tomato-paste" data-question="Which regions report the lowest levels in tomato Paste?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Which regions report the lowest levels in tomato Paste?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Among GEMS/Food reporting regions, tomato Paste, as sold had the lowest lead subgroup median in PAHO (3.2 µg/kg) and the highest in PAHO (250 µg/kg); reporting regions are markets, not growing areas.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> For cadmium, the lowest regional median was in EURO (30 µg/kg) and the highest in EMRO (45.1 µg/kg).<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="how-much-of-the-arsenic-in-tomato-paste-is-inorganic" data-anchor="how-much-of-the-arsenic-in-tomato-paste-is-inorganic" data-question="How much of the arsenic in tomato Paste is inorganic?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>How much of the arsenic in tomato Paste is inorganic?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Inorganic arsenic, the more toxic form, was measured in 1 result from 1 source, far fewer than total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> WHO GEMS/Food submissions reported inorganic arsenic in tomato Paste, as sold from 1 result in 1 reporting region, with subgroup medians below 20 µg/kg, mostly non-detects.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>
